name: malikadai-bill-android
description: Malikadai voice-first Android grocery billing, with compact PDF receipts.

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android:debug: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/prepare-android-manifest.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.verify: npm test && node --check scripts/prepare-android-manifest.mjs && node --check src/voice-ui.js && node --check src/voice-parser.js && node --check src/mobile-bridge.js && node --check server/transcription-server.mjs && node --check src/compact-receipt.js
